name: Hanseatic war against Valdemar IV of Denmark
summary: Valdemar IV's sack of the Hansa-protected port of Visby on Gotland (1361) triggers a multi-year naval war by the Wendish-circle towns against Denmark. The Treaty of Stralsund (1370) ends hostilities on Hanseatic terms, granting the League sweeping commercial privileges and veto on Danish royal succession.

_quarry.structural_significance: Highest sovereign-level political achievement of the Hanseatic League; the Stralsund settlement defines northern-European commercial-political order for a century.
